name: crowell_multisection_per_block
statistic: DiD(gene) = Delta(gene) - Delta(KRT8), on log_separation; the false-positive floor cancels
unit: tissue block, not section (invariant 5; 231 and 232 are one)
does_not_separate: compositional from intrinsic — the control rises with epithelial fraction. Amendment 2.

verdict.verdict: BELOW THE INTERVAL FLOOR — 2 BLOCK(S), REPORTED SIDE BY SIDE
verdict.detail: GUCA2A mean DiD -1.176 over 2 block(s), all same sign: True. **No interval, by §6.** CDX2 mean DiD +0.102 — §7's discriminator, and at this n it discriminates nothing yet. Sign agreement across a handful of blocks is not evidence of an effect size; it is what it says.
